title: Smart probiotics can sense high blood sugar and release GLP-1 on demand
desc: For people living with diabetes, managing blood sugar can mean constantly watching the clock, keeping meals and medications on schedule and staying alert to changes in glucose levels. While little can be done about timed meals, researchers have developed a biological system that detects rising blood sugar levels and automatically responds by releasing medication to bring glucose back down.

title: Oldest human brain cells grown in lab 'recorded passage of time'
